title: Kinsman-Redeemer
summary: A kinsman-redeemer was a near relative who could act to redeem property, preserve family inheritance, or protect vulnerable family members.
background: The background is important in Ruth, where Boaz’s actions combine covenant faithfulness, family responsibility, and gracious provision.
teachingHelp: Teach the kinsman-redeemer theme with care: explain the immediate legal-family setting first, then show how redemption language prepares hearts to treasure Christ.
